cr_data.provenance: The artist; given to Adah Mann Begg, Cobham, VA, 1907; bequeathed to her husband, Robert Burns Haldene Begg, Blacksburg, VA, 1955; bequeathed to their son, James Currie Begg, Pompano Beach, FL, 1964; given to his wife, Harriet Begg, Pompano Beach, FL, 1994; her gift to the Gallery in 1996 (Source: MAG, 2025)

description: Adah Mann was one of the artist's friends. A woman, seen in profile with her hair pinned up in a bun, looks downward. The softly rendered portrait appears on a piece of plain white paper in an oval shape. The letters ADAH appear vertically oriented on the lower right side of the portrait.
